# Memory Entry Template

## Title

Short durable fact or decision.

## Why This Belongs In Memory

Explain why this should survive beyond a single task.

## Source of Truth

Link the file, route, doc, or system that actually owns the fact.

## Last Verified

Use an explicit date like `2026-03-13`.
If you rely on an entry for current work and it is getting old, update this after re-checking the source of truth.

## Revisit Trigger

State what event or date should cause this entry to be rechecked.
Prefer task-driven triggers or clear change events over vague reminders.

## Do Not Include

- Full task logs
- Entire discussion summaries
- Temporary debugging notes
